name: Do Si Korean BBQ
tagline: All-you-can-eat Korean BBQ on Alki Beach and in Kent, WA
description: All-you-can-eat Korean BBQ in Seattle. Premium cuts grilled at your table, endless banchan, soju and cocktails, at our Alki Beach waterfront and Kent, WA restaurants.
_menuPhotos: placeholders: every dish shows a photo slot, empty ones as placeholders (for review). only-real: only dishes with a photo file show one. none: no photos on menus.

promoPopup.alt: 30% off Wednesdays at Do Si Korean BBQ. For a limited time, dine-in only, at Kent (12912 SE Kent-Kangley Rd) and Alki Beach (2516 Alki Ave SW).
promoPopup._help: The popup shown once per visit (not on the menu pages): the graphic in 'image' plus a Reserve button. 'alt' is what screen readers and Google read, so keep it matching the graphic. Set enabled to false to turn it off; change 'id' when the offer changes so people who closed the old one see the new one.
